problems.symptom: Promote gate re-evaluates the same 55 templates ~360x/month, 99.7% promote at minimum samples
problems.root_cause: Gate re-runs on already-promoted templates; threshold satisfied at n=3

problems.symptom: Capacity or busy refusals counted as failed attempts; hopeless categories sealed; landability < 0.25 auto-close
problems.root_cause: Attempt accounting does not separate lane refusal from drafter failure. Category priors are consulted before per-gap evidence.

problems.symptom: Classes with 0 lands deprioritised; selection favours classes that land easily
problems.root_cause: Landability posteriors reward the easy/hollow classes and suppress hard classes indefinitely.

problems.symptom: Autonomy admission was widened and tightened twice in 48h: ~250 to 2-5, then widened, then 8 landings with 1 improvement, then tightened again
problems.root_cause: No machine-measurable criterion decides supply against quality; the operator hand-edits one pool record

problems.symptom: Well-formed gaps are never selected because their category has attempts>=8 and lands=0
problems.root_cause: hopeless() keyed by category, not by gap; the only escape is human answers routed to an unread surface

problems.symptom: hopeless() category seal excludes gap families permanently; only escape is a human verb that is never read or answered
problems.root_cause: Designed escape routed to an unread/unattended/replaced surface; answers are unseals with lane cost

problems.symptom: Static CATEGORY_WEIGHT; momentum store poisoned by unreachable arms; calibration patch named as a specific path

Categories seal at 8+ attempts with 0 lands. The only escape posts to an unread vessel (248 unanswered). Load-timeout false negatives feed calibration. New gaps filed into sealed categories escalate immediately.
problems.root_cause: The seal learns from mislabeled failures, and its human exit is pinned to a replaced peer.

problems.symptom: Whole gap categories permanently unselectable, including operator measurement findings
problems.root_cause: hopeless() hard-excludes by CATEGORY at 8/0; triage-only, kill-switch and relocation runs count as failures; the escalation answer is unread; recommit children inherit a healthy category

problems.symptom: Categories sealed (orphaned_capability 346/0, 13 sealed). The only escape (a human answer) never converts. 248 escalations were unanswered.
problems.root_cause: hopeless() reads the calibration file, and provide_information writes no field compose reads.

problems.symptom: hopeless() seals 13 categories (481 attempts), concentrated on self-repair categories
problems.root_cause: Trained on the landed_commit evidence class (0/1030 holds); an 8-attempt threshold at a ~3% base rate false-seals 78-92%; immortal counters vs an expiring store; fragmented free-text categories

problems.symptom: Node 2 admits 0 of 863 hours after claims of 7 and 59 admitted
problems.root_cause: Node-local calibration plus scope/needs_information exclusions; the gap-compose watchdog cannot tell starvation from a hang

problems.symptom: Thompson rerank sorted by class theta first, so a score-0 gap in a fresh class won; three landability models, none calibrated; gap-landability-model.ts imported by nothing
Gaps parked pending forever (432 picks, 0 composes); seal escape unreadable
problems.root_cause: Pending derived from git with no measurement predicate; only exit is human answer on unread channel or revert

problems.symptom: Posteriors sealed or inflated: gap-class alpha=1 on every class on both nodes; rhythm credit 94-98% on 0-20% reach; gap-closing alpha 755.5; env-gate gaps permanently debited
problems.root_cause: No closure-based reward event; credit on fire, not outcome; no debit decay

problems.symptom: The category seals (346 attempts / 0 lands for orphaned_capability, 42 unrelated gaps unpickable) while each gap forgets. 19 pending_verification gaps absorb 100% of picks.
problems.root_cause: Amnesia at gap grain combined with permanent memory at category grain. Refusal does not feed back into ranking.

problems.symptom: Categories sealed at >=8 attempts / 0 lands; BUSY refusals and triage counted as attempts
problems.root_cause: counter written by one mechanism and read as evidence by another; lands recorded only at closure, which exclusion prevents

hopeless() seals by category; escalations unanswered or truncated at 2000 chars; 67 carry falsifier none
